mechanism: Store A binary-tree children as positive parent-relative distances below32768, zero for absent/expired edges; retain all full32bit root/near/short timestamps. Decode relative to the actual live parent, not the query position, to avoid stale-window aliasing. This halves the65536-entry child array.
difference_from_old_work: Prior compact heads/predecessors in fast and SF families did not guarantee speed. This targets a different large child working set and preserves root age checks/hash/search depth. Links outside the window are only discarded when already unusable in all later queries; finite/public parity and measured timing must test the implementation.
